scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @kanban/api & npm run dev -w @kanban/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const path of ['apps/api/dist', 'apps/web/dist', 'test-results', 'playwright-report', 'coverage']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
